point_one_role_text: A mechanistic nuance: frame the treatment as a possible temporary B-cell reset, not permanent B-cell deletion. The key development is the trajectory from deep B-cell depletion in blood, bone marrow, and cerebrospinal fluid to median B-cell reappearance about two months later.
point_two_role_text: An interpretive lens on the study’s breadth: distinguish a promising cross-disease platform signal from one unified efficacy result. The four disorders were evaluated through different clinical and biological endpoints, so the findings cannot be read as a single overall response rate.
